# @loom/isolate

K7 data-plane isolation — run tool effects in a separate authority domain (child process with scrubbed env), with kernel-side egress brokering (allowlist + resolve-and-pin, EGRESS_DENIED) and per-tool credential injection

## Entry points

- `@loom/isolate`

## Install

Unpublished for now: inside this repo use `workspace:*`; from a sibling checkout use a `link:` override (see [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md)).
